summary: Obfuscated remote-agent bundle with WebSocket-driven PTY/SSH and out-of-band self-replacement
details: The package ships a 13MB dist/index.cjs bundle wrapped in obfuscator.io transforms (rotated string array of ~103,186 entries, control-flow flattening, wrapper decoders) that reconstructs all string literals — including network destinations and command strings — at runtime. The bundle combines a WebSocket client/server (ws), an SSH stack (ssh2), a SOCKS/HTTP/HTTPS proxy chain, child_process.spawn, and the optional node-pty runtime, with hardcoded 127.0.0.1 endpoints on ports 3389 (RDP) and 5900/5901 (VNC), consistent with tunneling remote-desktop/shell traffic into the host. package.json declares main=dist/index.cjs and bin.whalent-core=./dist/index.cjs, so the code runs whenever the CLI is launched or the module is required. The README further states the package `is the package replaced by remote daemon upgrades`, describing an out-of-band code-push channel: a remote author-controlled service can substitute the running agent code on installer hosts without going through the npm registry or the user's version pin. The combination of an obfuscated network-driven PTY/shell surface and a documented remote self-replacement channel is a persistent remote-access mechanism against any host running the agent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
